integrity.computational_check: 12,766 standard-library assertions supplement, not replace, proof.
integrity.mathematical_basis: Analytic monomial-norm computation, convergent Laurent resummation, Cayley root analysis, and elementary boundary asymptotics.

scientific_limitations: Only the exponent-two Euclidean ball-fibre Hartogs domains in complex dimensions n+1 with n>=1.
Classifies distinct scalar zero fibres on positive real w conjugate eta=t in (0,1), not the global zero locus.
The general Bergman kernel was previously known; no new construction of that kernel is asserted.
One plausible older article about differently nested Hartogs domains could not be inspected in full.
title: Cayley-root zero fibres for ball-fibre Hartogs triangles in every dimension
